name: Chestnuts
summary: Hạt dẻ is on the town grill list, with the meat and the eggs. It is not described as a sweet course.
origin: Named among the cold-night grills in town.
howToEat: From the grill. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Hồ Sa Pa and the road down to the market. The hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Chestnuts in Sapa — on the cold-night grill
seoDescription: Hạt dẻ grilled with the other town snacks at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market.
